name: opencode
description: Provider-agnostic coding agent for the terminal, with a beta desktop app, that ships a full-access build agent and a read-only plan agent.
whatItDoes: opencode lets developers explore, plan and change a codebase from a terminal interface. A build agent can edit and run things, while a plan agent only analyses and suggests. It is not tied to a single model vendor.
howItWorks: The tool runs an agent loop with file, search and shell tools. Users switch between the built-in agents, and a general-purpose subagent handles multi-step searches and delegated work. It is installed as a single binary or an npm package.

requirements.name: Model provider account or API key
requirements.description: Access to the model that powers the agent
